children: Stock market today, Oct. 13 -- In a major move towards UPI MDR implementation in India, the NPCI today announced that the decision has been delayed until Diwali 2026. After the announcement, fintech stocks - Paytm, Pine Labs, PB Fintech, Groww, Mobikwik witnessed a strong rebound from today's lows.
After the new break about the UPI MDR fee delay till Diwali 2026, fintech stocks witnessed strong buying at the lower levels.
Pine Labs share price shot up from today's low of Rs.154.42 apiece to Rs.165 per share levels.
Zaggle Prepaid share price bounced back from Rs.163.87 to Rs.165.50, Paytm brand parent One97 Communications share price bounced back from Rs.1571 to Rs.1675 within a few minutes.
One MobiKwik Systems share price zoomed from Rs.230.41 to Rs.148 per share levels.
